title: Clients
wikitext:
Several different clients for QuakeWorld with different feature sets exists for a variety of platforms.

= Actively Maintained =

* [[DarkPlaces]]: advanced graphical capabilities
* [[ezQuake]]: modern feature set for competitive gaming
* [[Fodquake]]: fast, lightweight and portable
* [[FTE QW]]: also supports NetQuake, Hexen II and Quake II/III.
* [[FTEDroid]]: a port of [[FTE QW]] to Android

= Obsolete and Unmaintained =

* [[FuhQuake]]: once popular QW client
* [[id Software's Quake client]]: the original client
* [[MQWCL]]: MoreQW CLient
* [[TyrQuake]]: conservative enhancement of [[id Software's Quake client]]
* [[ZQuake]]: seminal QW client

= Client Packages =

Client packages are not clients themselves. Instead they bundle an existing client with assets (maps, textures, etc.) and configuration to make it easy for new players to get started. The following client packages are available:

* [[AfterQuake]]: bundles [[FTE QW]] with all necessary files
* [[classiQ]]: bundles [[Fodquake]] with all necessary files
* [[nQuake]]: bundles [[ezQuake]] with all necessary files
